title: L4 Rubric — five required scoring dimensions (amendment B2 / LOCK-03)
description: Every L4 rubric must declare exactly these five dimensions (each scored 0-2 by the Checker), weights summing to 1, and a weighted-total threshold on the 0-2 scale. Enforced by core/harness/loop-runner/validator.ts and core/governance/schemas/checker-report.schema.json (LOCK-03); helpers live in checker/rubric-template.ts.

dimensions.description: Exactly the 5 dimensions from Osmani et al. 06 leader rec #2.

threshold.description: Pass = weighted total (sum of score 0-2 x weight) >= threshold. 1.6 == the 0.8 verdict gate.

guidance.description: Overall judging instructions prepended to the judge prompt.

weight.description: All five weights must sum to 1.

guidance.description: What a 2 looks like for this dimension.
